primary: paired absolute difference in net utility per service CPU second, A3 minus A1
intervals: paired block bootstrap, 20000 resamples, Bonferroni 98.333% two-sided intervals for 3 contrasts; 95% descriptive intervals also
pooled: equal condition weights; independently resample paired blocks within condition
measurement_boundary: engine cgroup endpoints bracket storage snapshots, submission, drain, verification, and sampling; probe CPU includes oracle verification; host Docker CLI CPU is unmeasured
memory_polling: sequential cgroup reads, then 250ms wait; actual timestamps retained; peaks between samples unobserved
exclusions: none; integrity, HTTP, unresolved and HELD failures remain in denominator
calibration_gate: paired trace Brier difference upper 95% bound <0
primary_relative_claim: absolute contrast requires >10% reference scale estimate and adjusted lower bound >5% reference scale; no total utility loss; all guardrails
